rationale: Charlie's conviction that AI is expanding who can build software pairs directly with Georgi's mission to let small teams punch above their weight through automation—both see developer tools and no-code platforms as the lever. Georgi is actively hiring for GTM and running hackathons to distribute Rilo, while Charlie has deep experience building platforms that reached 3M+ developers and mentoring founders; Charlie's React Native and cross-platform expertise could also inform how Rilo thinks about builder workflows.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet Georgi—he's building Rilo, an AI-powered GTM automation platform for startups, and is actively recruiting and running hackathons to reach builders; given your conviction on AI expanding who can ship software and your experience scaling Expo to millions of developers, you two should connect on distribution strategy and what developer tools need to win in an agentic era.
